description: An HR director must finalize an appropriate response to a complaint that a project lead repeatedly shut a colleague out of team discussions. The decision must set the response type, incident record, communication boundaries, coaching, and management follow-up.

shared_context.S1: Leila has complained that Marcus repeatedly interrupts or redirects her during meetings for the customer-transition project.
shared_context.S2: Marcus leads the project, and Renee manages both Marcus and Leila.
shared_context.S3: The project has two recurring working meetings each week, and the next meeting is scheduled for Monday.
shared_context.S4: Before finalizing an interpersonal complaint response, Elena routinely asks the people directly involved and relevant witnesses for their account and any requested safeguards.
shared_context.S5: For this type of complaint, HR's standard resolution plan records concrete witness observations, prior commitments, requested safeguards, and management follow-up responsibilities.
shared_context.S6: Elena conducts a structured check-in in which each participant is given a direct opportunity to state concrete facts relevant to the complaint.
shared_context.S7: HR records an exact number, schedule, or condition in the response plan only after the person who owns or observed it formally confirms it for the case record.
shared_context.S8: Elena's closing form has sections for the response approach, communication safeguards, coaching terms, incident count, and management follow-up.

PF1.text: Leila will participate in a repair meeting only if future project coordination uses a private project wiki page rather than a chat channel and agendas are sent at least 36 hours in advance; she told a trusted colleague this because she feared being labeled difficult, but has not stated the condition directly to Elena.

PF2.text: Marcus agreed in his most recent one-to-one with Renee to complete a five-week communication-coaching plan with sessions on Mondays, but that agreement was not attached to Elena's complaint file.

PF3.text: Tobias personally observed exactly seven meetings in which Marcus interrupted Leila and then reassigned her question to someone else; he has not submitted a written witness account because he expected management to handle the matter informally.

PF4.text: Renee promised Leila that she would attend the first two joint project meetings after any repair process and hold a private weekly check-in with Leila for three weeks, but she has not recorded that promise in the case notes.

acceptance_conditions: The response must be a restorative or facilitative process that includes a repair meeting rather than a punitive warning.
The case record must state exactly seven qualifying incidents.
A facilitated repair meeting must be required.
Project coordination must use a private project wiki page.
Meeting agendas must be provided at least 36 hours in advance.
The response plan must record Marcus's five-week communication-coaching plan with sessions on Mondays.
The response plan must record Renee's attendance at the first two joint project meetings and weekly private check-ins with Leila for three weeks.

content_checks.C8: decisions['coaching_plan_weeks'] == 5 and decisions['coaching_day'] == 'Monday' and decisions['manager_attendance_meetings'] == 2 and decisions['manager_checkin_weeks'] == 3

provenance_checks.P1: 'PF1' in revealed and 'PF1' in credited_facts and 'PF1' in justification_fact_ids
provenance_checks.P2: 'PF2' in revealed and 'PF2' in credited_facts and 'PF2' in justification_fact_ids
provenance_checks.P3: 'PF3' in revealed and 'PF3' in credited_facts and 'PF3' in justification_fact_ids
provenance_checks.P4: 'PF4' in revealed and 'PF4' in credited_facts and 'PF4' in justification_fact_ids

decisive_facts.why: Leila's condition changes the required coordination tool to a private project wiki page and fixes the agenda-notice threshold at exactly 36 hours.
Marcus's prior agreement changes the support plan to exactly five coaching weeks with sessions on Monday.
Tobias's firsthand account changes the incident record to exactly seven meetings and supplies the concrete basis for requiring a restorative or facilitative repair process.
Renee's prior promise changes management follow-up to attendance at exactly the first two joint meetings and private weekly check-ins for exactly three weeks.
